item.title: SCOTTISH CUP DRAW: CELTIC v DUNDEE
item.description: CELTIC will face Dundee in the Scottish Cup Fifth Round at Parkhead next month. item.title: ‘FAIR IDEA OF WHAT WE NEED TO DO,’ O’NEILL EYES SIGNINGS
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL admitted Celtic have “a fair idea of what we need to do” on the transfer front following an unconvincing display in the 2-0 Scottish Cup Fourth Round win over Auchinleck Talbot at Rugby Park last night. item.title: Performance credit remains in Ayrshire
item.description: It was never going to be Brazil 1970 but Celtic’s 2-0 win over Auchinleck Talbot fell considerably short of even low expectations. item.description: CELTIC have stepped up their search for a striker with a move for Lorient striker Mohamed Bamba.
